name: Vouch
long_description:
Vouch is the new-age wealth manager for India’s young and ambitious professionals, with no minimums. India’s wealth industry is antiquated: great help starts at Rs 5 crore, and everyone else is left with a local agent or a trading app. Vouch’s AI agents, trained by experienced wealth managers, are filling the void: they plan your money, act on it once you approve, and keep it on track.

Indians are getting wealthier and moving that wealth into markets: $2.37 trillion in new financial wealth by 2030, and stocks and mutual funds up from 2% to 15% of household savings since 2012. At Vouch, we're starting with mutual funds before growing into the one place this burgeoning, new India manages its money.
one_liner: Personal wealth manager for 100M+ Indian professionals
